description: Read-only MCP server for self-hosted Atlassian Bamboo CI/CD
name: io.github.hmdmph/bamboo-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Bamboo server, e.g. https://bamboo.example.com
environmentVariables.name: BAMBOO_URL

environmentVariables.description: Bamboo personal access token. Read permission is sufficient.
environmentVariables.name: BAMBOO_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Transport mode. Must be stdio when the client runs the container.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT

environmentVariables.description: HTTP proxy URL, if Bamboo is only reachable via a proxy.
environmentVariables.name: BAMBOO_PROXY

environmentVariables.description: Bitbucket base URL, used to build source links in build results.
environmentVariables.name: BITBUCKET_URL

environmentVariables.description: Set to true to log requests and errors to stderr.
environmentVariables.name: VERBOSE

title: Bamboo MCP Server
